paragraphs: 2 former Mustangs appeared in professional games on Thursday for 2 clubs across 2 levels, with Ryan Tayman producing the night's most notable performance.
Ryan Tayman went 0-for-2, 1 run scored, 3 walks.
St. Lucie Mets beat Jupiter Hammerheads, 7-2.
Brooks Lee also appeared for Minnesota Twins. He went 0-for-4. He batted 8th and started at 3B. Minnesota Twins fell to Philadelphia Phillies, 1-7.
title: Ryan Tayman highlights a busy Thursday for former Mustangs
